Extremely disappointed/bad service. Good food.
Aug 2020
The good, the bad and the extremely ugly. This is how I would describe this place.

I went in here for breakfast, yes for this is a breakfast, brunch or lunch place only and are shut in the evenings. My standard measurement of a good breakfast are the coffee and the scrambled eggs. On both visits, I ordered a Vietnamese iced black coffee, no major complaints here although the coffee wasn't strong enough, just adequate. Food was a different matter entirely matter for it was excellent. The scrambled eggs on both occasions were delicious, the the muffins were also very good.

Onto the "bad & ugly". I entered the restaurant and there were 2 other single people occupying 4 seater tables. I tested myself at another 4-seater as the 2 seaters were effectively bar stools that looked uncomfortable. Okay, the waitress came over to tell me I had to move to a bar stool if the restaurant was filled up. My lucky day, she chose me to move and not the other 2 people who were also singular customers. 

Next, she hurriedly left the menu and rushed to open the door for other customers. She took took orders from the other customers, served food but never returned to ask for my food order. I literally, sat for 40 minutes before she came over as she wanted me to move to the bar stools, then realised at the same time that she hadn't taken my order. I then realised that I was asked to move tables because I was the only singular non-white customer this morning. It left me wondering if she didn't take my food order for the same reason. :( 

This is not acceptable and I apologetically blew my top off at the waitress. Only saving grace is that the manager offered not to charge me for the meal, a gesture that I politely declined.

Alex_H
Dear Hornswoggle 08, 

Thanks for coming to Café Marcel. We are sorry that you didn't enjoy your experience. 

Our truffle tagliatelle's portion is 150g while regular pasta portion is normally 120g in most of the restaurants. We use truffle oil, truffle paste and imported truffle from Italy. 

We add 10% VAT and 5%, like many restaurants here. It's quite common for premium restaurants here, which have a top location, and providing an excellent service (most of our reviews mention it), knowing that tip is also pretty inexistant here. 
And it's written at the bottom of the menu's first page. Honestly it's hard to miss as it's written just under the brunch combo offer. 

In any case, you could have raised the seasoning problem to our staff, or express your frustration, we would have come with a proper solution. We like our customers to leave happy from our restaurant. 

Finally, if you think that 9.90 USD (this is including the additional 15%) is overpriced for homemade pasta with real imported truffle, then you must find many restaurants overpriced I guess 😂

Best, 
The Café Marcel Team
